The '''Eye of the Sun''' was a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-imbued [[Light side artifact|artifact]] that was created by a group of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] for use during the [[Ruusan campaign]] as a defense against the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]]. It was later hidden under the [[Ch'hala tree|ch'hala]] [[Heart Tree]] on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] and the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Len Markus]] tried to find it there in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], because if he touched it against the [[Darkstaff]], then the staff would gain enough power to destroy Cularin.

It resembled a rock, but it could glow silver and a large yellow eye could appear on its surface, if it willed.
